description: Pinned upstream sources for the Pocket Realm offline build. Every entry has an exact commit, a license, and a redistribution verdict. Update only via a reviewed change that re-runs verification. This file is the source of truth referenced by the build/import tools.

sources.role: Vanilla 1.12 game server core (mangosd + realmd). Cross-compiled to arm64-v8a; refactored into an embeddable lifecycle in O04.

redistribution.notes: GPL-2.0 source may be redistributed. Compiled server binaries are linked by the Android app under GPL terms. The server is never translated; only the user-supplied client runs under translation.

sources.role: Reference database schemas/fixtures used to establish known-correct behavior before SQLite translation (O06-O07).
sources.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (code); content is Blizzard copyrighted material

redistribution.notes: The SQL/code is GPL-3.0. The game CONTENT in this database is Blizzard's copyrighted material; CMaNGOS asserts a non-commercial fair-use claim. Pocket Realm treats all derived data as non-redistributable proprietary material: it is generated on-device from the user's own client (O10) and never shipped in source control or the release artifact. See DECISIONS.md #1.

sources.role: Bot subsystem populating the offline PvE world (protected/resident/elastic/latent classes, O18).

redistribution.notes: GPL-2.0, inherits CMaNGOS licensing. Built as part of the native realm library.

verification.rule: A firmware, driver, NDK, or upstream change invalidates affected qualification and requires a new reviewed entry with re-verification.
